about: An overlay on the frozen truth, never a modification of it: for each fact, whether the subject act's own text states the relation. Measured by plain string search, no model, each answer backed by a quoted span.
method: (1) the target's number in a sentence carrying the relation's verb; (2) the verb just after the number, with no other act number in between (act of accession); (3) under a list whose lead-in carries the verb; (4) in the annex of acts the relating article points to (recast). Values: yes | no (never named) | unclear (named, no relation sentence) | unknown (no searchable number, or no local text).

calibration_reading.repeals: 19 of the 21 the human found; 0 false claims on the 5 he refused; the 2 misses are a repeal the text never names and a target with no printed number
calibration_reading.amends: 13 of the 14 the human found that have a local text; precision not measured: his only two NO answers on amends both fall on acts whose text we do not hold

reserves: based_on is not measured: we hold the text of 15 % of its subject acts
a fact marked unclear or unknown is not evidence of absence
the calibration rests on one human reading 27 repeals and 33 amends
